biothings.name: sporadic breast cancer
biothings.definition: A carcinoma that arises from the breast and is not caused by inherited genetic mutations. [NCIT:P378]
biothings.synonyms: sporadic breast cancer, sporadic breast carcinoma

biothings.name: estrogen-receptor positive breast cancer
biothings.definition: A subtype of breast cancer that is estrogen-receptor positive [EFO:1000649]
biothings.synonyms: ER+ breast cancer, estrogen receptor positive breast cancer, oestrogen receptor positive breast cancer

biothings.name: estrogen-receptor negative breast cancer
biothings.definition: A subtype of breast cancer that is estrogen-receptor negative [EFO:1000650]

opentargets.name: breast cancer
opentargets.description: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the breast. The vast majority of cases are carcinomas arising from the breast parenchyma or the nipple. Malignant breast neoplasms occur more frequently in females than in males.

opentargets.name: breast carcinoma
opentargets.description: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the breast

opentargets.name: hereditary breast ovarian cancer syndrome
opentargets.description: An autosomal dominant inherited syndrome caused by mutations in the BRCA1 or BRCA2 genes. Patients are at high risk of developing breast cancer, particularly before the age of fifty, high risk of developing a second primary breast cancer, and high risk of developing both breast and ovarian cancer.

opentargets.name: breast-ovarian cancer, familial, susceptibility to, 1
opentargets.description: Any hereditary breast ovarian cancer syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the BRCA1 gene.

opentargets.name: breast-ovarian cancer, familial, susceptibility to, 2
opentargets.description: Any hereditary breast ovarian cancer syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the BRCA2 gene.
